mapper.select: SELECT rv.id AS report_version_id, rv.acceptance_id, a.project_id, a.project_task_id, rv.report_status FROM acc_acceptance_report_version rv JOIN acc_acceptance a ON a.tenant_id = rv.tenant_id AND a.id = rv.acceptance_id AND a.deleted = b'0' WHERE rv.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND rv.id = #{query.reportVersionId} AND rv.deleted = b'0'
